title: EI Graphics scope candidate
description: Evidence-linked scope candidate consumed by ei-scope-resolver at the scope-candidate stage. The candidate is a starting point: the model reviews and may adjust it before running New-EiProposedScope.ps1. status and generatedAt are not candidate fields; they are written by the scope resolver.

confidence.description: Scalar 0..1 expressing how confident the candidate generator is that the evidence is correct and complete. 0.5 is the default for auto-generated candidates.

rationale.description: Why this is believed to be the smallest defensible scope. Must explain the reasoning, not just list the files.

evidence.description: Every piece of evidence that supports a proposed file, module or test. Every proposedFile must cite at least one evidence id.

id.description: Unique identifier within this candidate (e.g. E1, E2).

value.description: The evidence value: story text, a file path, a vocabulary term, etc.

note.description: Optional free-text note explaining why this evidence was included.

proposedFiles.description: Files proposed for inclusion in the scope. Every entry must cite at least one evidence id from the evidence array.

symbols.description: Specific symbols within the file that are in scope.

evidence.description: Evidence ids from the evidence array that support this file.

confidence.description: Per-file confidence, may differ from the top-level candidate confidence.

proposedModules.description: Projects or assemblies that contain the proposed files.

relatedTests.description: Tests that verify the behaviour being changed.

protectedAreas.description: Path prefixes that must not be touched. The scope resolver enforces this.

dependencies.description: External code areas that the change touches but does not own.

excluded.description: Files or areas that were considered but deliberately excluded from scope.

unresolved.description: Open questions that must be answered before scope can be resolved.
